status: DEFINITION_ONLY — nothing is placed from this file until Jah approves the tree family (U11); then it drives the registry/migration that replaces the laser-plant family (U12)
_doc: master §14.6: deterministic seeded placement within eligible ground, excluding pathways, thresholds, landing pads, combat clearances, solids and important sightlines. All distances in plaza metres (spawn 0,4). The preview tool deploy/botany_placement_preview.mjs evaluates this mask against the actual FIELD layout (rules _runtime_mapping.field_colliders_district_v1) and reports counts/bounds without touching the scene.

eligible.label: plaza ring outside the arrival forecourt, inside the authored 112 m floor
district ground between the plaza and the landmark approaches

plaza_pathways.label: the four plaza → entrance inlays (2.6 m) + 1.6 m margin

secondary_streets.label: plaza → tree elevator, plaza → residential pods

district_routes.label: the radial route inlays plaza → each landmark (4.5 m) + 1 m margin

distribution.method: seeded cluster grammar: cluster centres on a jittered 16 m grid inside the eligible mask (60 % of cells kept), nearest the plaza first up to the hard cap; 3–6 specimens per cluster within 2.8 m; min spacing 1.7 m; variant / yaw / scale (0.97–1.03) from the seed

lod.far_variant: tree_spec.lod_far (no twigs, half the terminal leaves, 5 radial segments)
lod.note: LOD is a definition here; the runtime switch is built with the propagation step after approval
